integrity: The statement is proved from t-design incidence identities and checked by independent exact transforms of an explicit ternary Golay representation.
limitations: Finite-design theorem for the small Witt 5-(12,6,1) design only; not a general Steiner-design theorem. Historical priority is bounded by checked sources; independent validation not performed.
title: Exact Walsh spectrum and complement-even recovery for the small Witt design
